descriptor.scene: There is no human being anywhere in this frame, no daylight and no window to an outdoors. The camera is well back and the PLACE is the subject: this is the INTERIOR of one glowing machine, a warm workshop the size of a small hall. Cream-painted walls and honeyed wood beams curve overhead like the inside of a lantern. Low brass-and-wood rails run along the floor and away into the depth of the picture; two or three small rounded cream machines with simple amber dials stand along the walls; a honey-wood chute slopes down from an upper level at the right. Everything is still and warm and just-woken. The manager is small at his post near the centre, standing on a low wooden platform at the head of the rails, at full length and no taller than a third of the frame height, square and front-on, calm and attentive, mitten arms relaxed at his sides. His own plum light is the strongest light in the picture and it washes the nearest rails and the floor around him; everything else is warm cream-paper light. Composition: platform and manager centre-left, rails running from him toward the lower right, chute and machines receding right; the top right of the frame stays calm warm wall and light.
descriptor._caption: Inside every glowing machine of TastefulStories there lives a manager: a small plum-glowing figure in a cream newsboy cap. Each manager belongs to one person and nobody else. This one is June's.
negatives: a human being of any kind
an exterior view of the machine; the camera is INSIDE it
